events.title: Ape-tite is joining Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Ape-tite will be taking part in Steam Next Fest from 19-26 October.Whether you're returning for another shift or haven't yet stepped into the kitchen, Next Fest is a great opportunity to see what we've been cooking.You'll be able to explore different kitchen layouts, juggle dine-in and takeaway orders, and try to keep service running as the pressure builds.Thanks for following the game's development so far. We look forward to hearing your thoughts during the festival.See you in the kitchen.🦧🐵Ki-

events.title: Ape-tite is joining Cooking Fest
events.summary: How can we possibly miss a fest called Cooking Fest? Ape-tite will be taking part in Cooking Fest.In the demo, we have prepared 2 dishes for you to sample and a lot more in the coming EA that's coming REALLY soon~List of food you can expect in the Early Access: Curry FishballsEgg WafflesGrid Waffles3 Stuffed Treasures... And that's just for the first location~🦧🐵Ki-nodes Studio

events.title: Ape‑tite Demo v1.0.8
events.summary: 🦍Sing will show you the ropes...not really, just hand you a employee manual if you need it.ChangesSome QOL improvement.Adding Help/Hints in pause menu and in hub near the Mahjong table.Minor bugfix.Note: If you've played a previous version of the demo and are still seeing the old version after updating, please try reinstalling the demo.More fixes and improvements to come. Thanks for playing and for the feedback.— Ki-nodes

events.title: Ape‑tite Demo is Live! 🦍
events.summary: Ape‑tite Demo is Live! 🦍 🎮 The demo is now available on Steam.Play solo or together, and see how quickly things spiral out of control. 🙈🙉🙊🐵Coordination doesn’t tend to last very long.💬If you run into anything odd or completely broken, feel free to let me know. Thanks for checking it out. Ki-nodes---デモが公開されました。🦍ローカルまたはSteam Remote Playで遊べます。シンプルな協力クッキングゲームですが、すぐにカオスになります。不具合や気になる点があれば、 ぜひ教えてください。
